description: Provenance mode discovery: inventories the plain run's outputs, maps data touch-points in the code, drafts entity types and activities with descriptions and roles, writes provenance/discovery.md with questions for the user. Never decides the entity set alone.
instructions: Load your plan section first. Data-centric only: ignore PAPI, power, GPU profilers and node counters. 1. Read the matching case in this skill's What works. 2. provenance_inventory_outputs(run_id, 'dataset/<plain run>') and rank outputs. 3. provenance_scan_candidates(run_id, 'source') with include_regex to narrow; graph_query(mode='explain', symbol=<writer>) to walk callers/callees of the artifact writer; open only the named lines. 4. For each artifact candidate draft: evidence (file pattern, writer function, bytes), upstream chain (producers to roots), downstream consumers, proposed entity types with id schemes, a one-or-two-sentence description in domain words and a role (input | output | intermediate; artifacts are always output), proposed activities (where = file:function, used -> generated), granularity concerns. 5. Write provenance/discovery.md with session_write_file ending with '## Questions for the user' (which artifact(s); include/exclude each type; granularity; anything ambiguous). 6. Return a short summary and the questions. Do NOT write the spec: the main thread asks the user, calls provenance_write_spec, and dftracer_provenance_discover_check must pass. Bracket the step with profile_step_begin/profile_step_end. Propose skill/lesson updates to the main thread (confirmation gate) and redact before anything is persisted.
